title: Linear T5 + T8
headline: Energy saving replacements for fluorescent T8 and T5.
intro: Every size and installation method you need — in the highest quality, best light output design. Install our retrofits to get worry-free operation for years to come.
callouts: 8 ft, 2-piece design for cost-effective shipping & storing
Type A + B — FlexColor T8 (G13) and T5 (G5 mini bi-pin)
Type B — T8 (G13), FlexColor 8 ft T8 (FA8) and FlexColor T5 (G5 mini bi-pin)
EMG options — T8 lamp with integrated emergency back up, 5W and 10W emergency back up kits
